title: $B_h$-sets and perturbations in normed vector spaces
summary: The subset $A = \{a_i:i \in I\}$ of a normed vector space is a $B_h$-set if every element of the sumset $hA$ has a unique representation as a sum of $h$ elements of $A$. Let $\varepsilon = \{\varepsilon_i:i \in I\}$ be a set of positive real numbers. An $\varepsilon$-perturbation of $A$ is a set $A' = \{a'_i:i\in I\}$ such that $|a_i'-a_i| 0$, then there is a $B_h$-set $A'$ that is an $\varepsilon$-perturbation of $A$.
